tools.name: search_buddhist_canon
tools.description: Always call this tool before answering any request to find, quote, reproduce, verify, or cite Buddhist scripture—including when the user names a sutra, gives a quotation fragment, asks for original wording or a source, or uses simplified/traditional variants. Do not answer those requests from memory

tools.name: find_passages_for_situation
tools.description: Call this tool when a user describes a life situation and asks for relevant Buddhist scripture, Buddhist teaching, or a source-backed Buddhist perspective. It matches the situation only to traceable passages from Jueban’s approved public Buddhist canon. Do not call it for unrelated everyday question

tools.name: explain_buddhist_passage
tools.description: Always call this tool before explaining the meaning of a specific Buddhist quotation or passage. Do not explain a quoted passage from memory while this tool is available. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_buddhist_canon" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
